name: Ontiñena (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow eradicated tree bearing a small shield of the bars of Aragon, between two small trees.
history: Municipal flag of Ontiñena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
